impact.text: ETH sent to Core is stuck forever.

precondition_sources.text: The pool is initialized at tick 0 with liquidity.
The victim submits a swap with sqrtRatioLimit set near the current price for slippage protection, sending 10 ether as msg.value.

intent_sources.text: When a swap is submitted with msg.value greater than zero, the sent ETH must be accounted for in the pair debt system rather than left unaccounted.
